name: Achbor
overview: Achbor is a male Edomite mentioned in the genealogy of Genesis 36:38. He is primarily noted for being the father of Baal-hanan, which situates him within the Edomite tribal lineage. There are no additional notes or details about his life or character in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Achbor means 'mouse' or 'jerboa' in Hebrew, reflecting a proper name without indication that it was given directly by God. This meaning is recorded in Genesis 36:38 alongside his mention.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Achbor as the father of Baal-hanan, establishing his role within an Edomite family line. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Achbor's significance lies in his place within the Edomite genealogy, contributing to the biblical record of the descendants of Esau. His mention as Baal-hanan's father helps trace the leadership and lineage among the Edomites, underscoring the biblical emphasis on heritage and tribal identity. Although brief, this reference connects to the broader narrative of God's providence in preserving the history of His people.
